description: Deploy one Lumieree commit to the k3s cluster: fetch that commit and run deploy/deploy.sh from it. The only input is a 40-character git SHA, so the CI role cannot run arbitrary commands through this document.

tag.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA to deploy (also the container image tag).

runCommand: runuser -l ubuntu -c 'cd ~/lumieree && git fetch -q origin && git checkout -q -f {{ tag }} && bash deploy/deploy.sh {{ tag }}' 2>&1
